title: Nothing Black Can Do
setup: Black's rook is about to start eating your pawns, and you have no check worth giving. Find the move that leaves Black without a single useful reply.
hint: Your rook on h4 already stares at h7. Look at what your bishop on d4 does to the g7 pawn before you choose a square for the queen.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qf5}} gives no check and takes nothing. It lines the queen up on h7 beside the rook, and h7 falls next move.

Black has no way to stop it. The g7 pawn is pinned by your bishop on d4, so it can neither move nor capture. Making air with {{h6}} only opens the file: {{Rxh6#}}, and the pinned pawn cannot take back. Every other reply is mated on the h-file.
